Very restrained natural-color starting point with smooth highlight roll-off and gentle skin lift.
Cool/tungsten night palette with warm/red highlight tendency. Halation/grain must be separate from LUT.
Vivid glossy portrait direction: bright clean mids, cobalt-blue boost, luminous warm skin, cool shadows, warm highlight glow. Generator: generate-absolute-hero.js.
